class.name: OcgAISTrihedron
class.brief_description: Create a selectable trihedron The trihedron includes 1 origin, 3 axes and 3 labels. Default text of labels are "X", "Y", "Z". Color of origin and any axis, color of arrows and labels may be changed. Visual presentation might be shown in two, shaded and wireframe modes, wireframe by default). There are 4 modes of selection: - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_EntireObject to select trihedron, priority = 1 - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_Origin to select its origin, priority = 5 - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_Axes to select its axis, priority = 3 - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_MainPlanes to select its planes, priority = 2
class.description: ! Create a selectable trihedron ! The trihedron includes 1 origin, 3 axes and 3 labels. ! Default text of labels are "X", "Y", "Z". ! Color of origin and any axis, color of arrows and labels may be changed. ! Visual presentation might be shown in two, shaded and wireframe modes, wireframe by default). ! There are 4 modes of selection: ! - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_EntireObject to select trihedron, priority = 1 ! - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_Origin to select its origin, priority = 5 ! - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_Axes to select its axis, priority = 3 ! - AIS_TrihedronSelectionMode_MainPlanes to select its planes, priority = 2 ! ! Warning! ! For the presentation of trihedron, the default unit of length is the millimetre, ! and the default value for the representation of the axes is 100. ! If you modify these dimensions, you must temporarily recover the Drawer. ! From inside it, you take the aspect in which the values for length are stocked. ! For trihedron, this is Prs3d_Drawer_LineAspect. ! You change the values inside this Aspect and recalculate the presentation.

method.name: AIS_Trihedron
method.description: Initializes a trihedron entity.

method.name: DatumDisplayMode
method.description: Returns datum display mode.

method.name: SetDatumDisplayMode
method.description: Sets Shading or Wireframe display mode, triangle or segment graphic group is used relatively.

method.name: Component
method.description: Returns the right-handed coordinate system set in SetComponent.

method.name: SetComponent
method.description: Constructs the right-handed coordinate system aComponent.

method.name: HasOwnSize
method.description: Returns true if the trihedron object has a size other than the default size of 100 mm. along each axis.

method.name: Size
method.description: Returns the size of trihedron object; 100.0 by DEFAULT.

method.name: SetSize
method.description: Sets the size of trihedron object.

method.name: UnsetSize
method.description: Removes any non-default settings for size of this trihedron object. If the object has 1 color, the default size of the drawer is reproduced, otherwise DatumAspect becomes null.

method.name: HasTextColor
method.description: Returns true if trihedron has own text color

method.name: TextColor
method.description: Returns trihedron text color

method.name: SetTextColor_1
method.description: Sets color of label of trihedron axes.

method.name: SetTextColor_2
method.description: Sets color of label of trihedron axis.

method.name: HasArrowColor
method.description: Returns true if trihedron has own arrow color

method.name: ArrowColor
method.description: Returns trihedron arrow color

method.name: SetArrowColor_1
method.description: Sets color of arrow of trihedron axes.

method.name: SetArrowColor_2
method.description: Sets color of arrow of trihedron axes.

method.name: DatumPartColor
method.description: Returns color of datum part: origin or some of trihedron axes.

method.name: SetDatumPartColor
method.description: Sets color of datum part: origin or some of trihedron axes. If presentation is shading mode, this color is set for both sides of facing model

method.name: SetOriginColor
method.description: Sets color of origin. Standard_DEPRECATED("This method is deprecated - SetColor() should be called instead")

method.name: SetXAxisColor
method.description: Sets color of x-axis. Standard_DEPRECATED("This method is deprecated - SetColor() should be called instead")

method.name: SetYAxisColor
method.description: Sets color of y-axis. Standard_DEPRECATED("This method is deprecated - SetColor() should be called instead")

method.name: SetAxisColor
method.description: Sets color of z-axis. Standard_DEPRECATED("This method is deprecated - SetColor() should be called instead")

method.name: ToDrawArrows
method.description: Returns true if arrows are to be drawn

method.name: SetDrawArrows
method.description: Sets whether to draw the arrows in visualization

method.name: SelectionPriority
method.description: Returns priority of selection for owner of the given type

method.name: SetSelectionPriority
method.description: Sets priority of selection for owner of the given type

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Sets the color theColor for this trihedron object, it changes color of axes.

method.name: AcceptDisplayMode
method.description: Returns true if the display mode selected, aMode, is valid for trihedron datums.

method.name: Signature
method.description: Returns index 3, selection of the planes XOY, YOZ, XOZ.

method.name: Type
method.description: Indicates that the type of Interactive Object is datum.

method.name: UnsetColor
method.description: Removes the settings for color.

method.name: ClearSelected
method.description: Method which clear all selected owners belonging to this selectable object ( for fast presentation draw ).

method.name: HilightOwnerWithColor
method.description: Method which hilight an owner belonging to this selectable object ( for fast presentation draw ).
